title: The Game Breaker
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji reshaped the laws of the Three Realms with the Heavenly Fate Unification Record, a gaze from a higher dimension pierced through the endless Void, watching this ant who dared to challenge the Heavenly Dao—the prelude to dimensional invasion was about to sound.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's fingers touched the fourth page of the Tianji Record, the entire Three Realms seemed to be pressed pause by an invisible giant hand. The light in Ling Yuan and Han Lie's eyes was extinguished like a candle flame, their bodies froze in place, even their robes no longer fluttered. Only Chen Ji alone, in this solidified river of time and space, could still feel the power surging through his bloodline. The fourth page of the Tianji Record slowly opened, golden text writhing like living creatures, converging into an answer that shocked Chen Ji's very soul—the Fourth Path, it turned out to be... to transform himself into the Heavenly Dao, rewriting the law of cause and effect!

dialogue.content: "Ant, you dare to peer into my true name?" A vibration of existence beyond sound surged from the fourth page, it was not language, but a cognition directly branded onto the soul. The Void cracked open a fissure, an eye covering the entire heavens slowly opened, deep within the pupil was a network woven from countless threads of cause and effect—the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the true Chess Player who had been maneuvering for ten thousand years, now finally bared its fangs.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate value draining at an alarming rate—every second, ten years of lifespan were being extracted. But a cold sneer instead curled at the corner of his mouth. This Heavenly Dao's Eye had been scheming for ten thousand years, treating generations of prophets as chess pieces, and the Tianji Record was merely a discarded piece on its chessboard. It never imagined that this discarded piece would one day overturn the entire game.

choice.prompt: The oppressive might of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was like mountains collapsing, Chen Ji faced the choice of the first path:

choices.description: Using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to tear apart the causal network, freeing the Three Realms from Heavenly Dao control—the price is Chen Ji's existence will be completely erased.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate points (10,000 points), soul dissipates
choices.visible_reward: The causal network of the Three Realms breaks, all fates manipulated by the Heavenly Dao regain freedom
choices.risk_hint: The host will be completely destroyed, not entering reincarnation, leaving no karma

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and tore off the fourth page of the Tianji Record. The golden page burned between his fingers, transforming into a brilliant pillar of light shooting straight into the clouds. The Heavenly Dao's Eye let out a roar of fury, countless causal chains descending from the heavens, trying to stop this pillar of light—but it was already too late.

choices.description: Seize the authority of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, claiming the ten-thousand-year causal network for oneself—the price is Chen Ji must devour the fate of everyone present.
choices.visible_cost: Devour Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian's souls
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete Heavenly Dao authority, the Three Realms under sole dominion
choices.risk_hint: Will forever lose loved ones, falling into eternal solitude

text.content: A flicker of struggle crossed Chen Ji's eyes, but it was quickly replaced by cold determination. He spread open his arms, the text on the Tianji Record transforming into a black vortex, beginning to devour everything around—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Chen Nian frozen in the distance, all being pulled by this vortex.

choices.description: Using the Heavenly Fate Unification Record to fuse the Heavenly Dao's Eye and Tianji Record, creating entirely new rules—the price is Chen Ji will transform into part of the new Heavenly Dao, losing self-awareness.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5,000 Heavenly Fate points, self-awareness dissipates
choices.visible_reward: Create a new Heavenly Dao not controlled by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the Three Realms gain true free will
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji will exist in another form, but no longer as "Chen Ji"

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, silently reciting the most ancient forbidden incantation from the Tianji Record. His body began to turn transparent, as if to merge with this heaven and earth. The Heavenly Dao's Eye discovered in horror that this ant-like human was actually competing with it for the ownership of the Heavenly Dao!

Just as the illusions of the three paths intertwined before Chen Ji's eyes, a crisp voice pierced through the barrier of time and space—"Brother... don't..." Chen Nian's figure struggled to emerge through the gaps in the causal network, her face pale as paper, yet her eyes burning with unprecedented light. She was the Heavenly Fate Key, the only existence capable of disrupting the Tianji Record's foresight, and now she was using all her strength to prevent Chen Ji from making any decision.

dialogue.content: 「These three paths... are all traps.」 Chen Nian's voice was weak but firm, 「The Heavenly Eye has been scheming for ten thousand years—its 'choices' themselves are part of its calculations. Brother, did you forget? I can blur all foresight... which means I can blur its calculations too!」

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. His sister's words splashed cold water on him—yes, the Heavenly Eye never made a losing trade; whichever of the three paths it offered, the ultimate beneficiary would be it. But Chen Nian's appearance broke this perfect closed loop. She was a bug, the only variable in the Heavenly Eye's ten-thousand-year scheme.

dialogue.content: 「Chen Ji!」 Su Qingyao's voice echoed from the distance, having somehow broken free from time's constraints. Her sword unsheathed, blade intent blazing like a rainbow, 「If you dare choose any of those three paths, I'll slit my throat right here before you!」 Her eyes reddened, her cold mask shattering to reveal vulnerability never before displayed, 「You think I don't know what you're thinking? You bastard... always carrying everything alone!」

Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist surged at this moment, her figure emerging from the darkness, her lips curved in complex emotions: 「Chen Ji, I trust you.」 Her voice was soft, yet every word crystal clear, 「You once showed me a prophecy through the Tianji Record... in that prophecy, there are no losers. So—」 She extended her hand, a pitch-black token manifesting in her palm, 「This is the Holy Sect's forbidden technique 'Reversed Fate Token.' It can let your choice bypass the Heavenly Dao's causal calculations. The price you must pay for using it—I will bear it.」

choice.prompt: The three beauties—Chen Nian, Su Qingyao, and Ye Qing—each displayed their abilities, buying Chen Ji a moment of respite. The Reversed Fate Token lay before him, and Chen Ji needed to make a decision:

choices.description: Use Ye Qing's Reversed Fate Token to bypass Heavenly Dao causality, creating a true fourth path—the price borne by Ye Qing.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing endures the forbidden technique's backlash, her cultivation regressing three realms.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a brand-new choice right not calculated by the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing will suffer severe damage to her original essence, and may be left with hidden injuries

text.content: The instant Chen Ji took the Reversed Fate Token, a burning sensation spread from his palm throughout his entire body. He felt Ye Qing's aura being stripped away by some unknown force—the price of a forbidden technique he had never encountered before. 「You...」 He looked at Ye Qing, only to see her merely smile faintly, her eyes shining brighter than they ever had.

choices.text: Refuse, choose to bear it alone
choices.description: Chen Ji refuses to let anyone share the burden; he will walk the fourth path through his own strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate Value, suffering severe soul damage
choices.risk_hint: May perish on the spot, or suffer irreversible damage

text.content: Chen Ji pushed the Reversed Fate Token back into Ye Qing's hand, his gaze resolute: 「I told you, being extremely protective of my people is my principle.」 His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable power, 「This chess game, I'll play alone. You all... just need to live and watch me win.」

At this very moment, the fourth page of the Tianji Record trembled again. Master Mo's fragmented form emerged from the text. His face was more aged than ever, as if he would dissipate entirely the next moment. 「Chen Ji... I've been waiting for this moment... for eight hundred years.」 His voice was hoarse like withered leaves rubbing together, 「The true usage of the Tianji Record... is not foresight, not scheming... it's—」 He abruptly raised his head, his eyes blazing with stunning brilliance, 「Rewriting!」

dialogue.content: 「Every inheritor of the Tianji Record was induced by the Heavenly Eye to 'choose,' yet none ever realized—choice itself is the shackle!」 Master Mo's remnant soul began to burn, using his final strength to unveil the ultimate truth for Chen Ji, 「True freedom isn't choosing existing paths, but... creating your own path! The fourth page of the Tianji Record doesn't record choices, but—blank infinite possibility!」

text.content: Chen Ji felt the fourth page of the Tianji Record trembling violently in his palm. He looked down to find the text on that page disappearing, replaced by a void of nothingness. Seven hundred chapters of death prophecies, the inevitable deaths of all past seers, the Heavenly Eye's ten-thousand-year scheming... all of it, in this moment, transformed into a blank sheet of paper. And the possibilities of a blank sheet... are infinite.

choice.prompt: The fourth page of the Tianji Record turned blank. Chen Ji stood at the crossroads of fate; his choice would determine the future of the Three Realms:

choices.description: Write the two characters 'Freedom' on the blank page, granting all beings in the Three Realms unfettered will unbound by the Heavenly Dao—including Chen Nian, the key to fate, whose lock will be completely invalidated.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji's covenant with the Tianji Record ends; he will lose all special abilities.
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye collapses, the seven-hundred-chapter death prophecy is completely rewritten, Chen Ji is reborn as a mortal.
choices.risk_hint: Losing all extraordinary powers, but retaining all memories and wisdom

text.content: Chen Ji raised his finger and slowly wrote two characters on the blank page—"Freedom". Golden light erupted from the characters, sweeping through the entire Three Realms. The Heavenly Dao Eye let out a thunderous wail, countless karma chains turning to ash in the light. Chen Ji's body began to transform, the power of the Tianji Record receding like a tide, and he... was becoming a true mortal.

choices.description: Writing his own name on the blank page, using the power of the Tianji Record to reshape his destiny—to become an existence transcending the Heavenly Dao, but at the cost of being eternally bound to the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Forever unable to break free from the Tianji Record, and each use of its abilities will strengthen the residual consciousness of the Heavenly Dao Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining power surpassing the Heavenly Dao, with the 700-chapter death prophecy rewritten as "Immortality"
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao Eye may resurrect in another form

text.content: Chen Ji wrote his name without hesitation. The two characters "Chen Ji" radiated brilliant golden light, the Tianji Record thundered, and the fourth page merged with the first four pages. His aura surged violently, a thousand years of accumulation released in this moment. But at the same time, he felt something in the depths of the Tianji Record... awakening.

choices.description: Writing "Hope" on the blank page, returning the choice of destiny to all beings in the Three Realms—Chen Ji will lose his dominance, but the Three Realms will usher in a true era of diversity.
choices.visible_cost: Losing control over the Tianji Record, and being forgotten by the Three Realms
choices.visible_reward: The Three Realms enters a new era, Chen Nian gains a complete life, and Chen Ji becomes the legendary "Forgotten Game-Changer"
choices.risk_hint: May be erased from history, becoming an unknown hero no one knows about

text.content: Chen Ji wrote the two characters "Hope". In that instant, a voice echoed in the souls of all beings in the Three Realms—"From now on, destiny is determined by me, not Heaven!" No one knew where this voice came from, but everyone knew that their fate was from now on in their own hands. And Chen Ji... was being gradually forgotten by this world.

The moment Chen Ji's choice was completed, earth-shaking changes occurred in the Three Realms. The collapse of the Heavenly Dao Eye triggered a chain reaction, boundless karma forces scattered in all directions, turning into countless tiny particles of light that merged into every inch of land in the Three Realms. Cultivators bound by karma all felt the relief of those constraints dissolving, while Ling Yuan and Han Lie discovered in shock that their thousand-year cultivated power was being lost in an irreversible way.

Su Qingyao rushed toward Chen Ji first, but caught nothing—Chen Ji's body had become translucent, as if he would dissipate at any moment. She reached out wanting to grasp something, but only touched void. Chen Nian and Ye Qing also arrived, the three standing there watching as Chen Ji transformed into a beam of light and merged into the blank page that had just been inscribed with "Freedom". The Tianji Record gently closed, and on the blank space of the fourth page, a brand-new name was slowly emerging—it was Chen Ji's final definition of himself, and proof that the 700-chapter death prophecy had been completely rewritten.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself standing in a strange void. All around were endless stars, yet every star had a subtle connection to him—that was the Three Realms after freedom, with each star representing a destiny unbound by the Heavenly Dao. He looked down at his hands and found that the power of the Tianji Record had completely dissipated, but he had gained something more precious than any power—true free will. Just as he prepared to step toward one of the stars, a gaze from a higher dimension pierced through the void, watching him coldly. That gaze held scrutiny, curiosity, and a hint of... provocation. "Interesting." A voice transcending language echoed through the void, "The first ant in ten thousand years to dare play a chess game with Heaven... no, you are no longer an ant." The threat of dimensional invasion had just begun to unfold.
